title: What is a market?
goal: A market is a place where buyers and sellers meet.

objectives.text: Say what the stock market is.
Say what can move a price.

slides.text: A market is a place where people buy and sell. A farm market sells fruit, eggs and bread.
slides.title: Markets

slides.text: At a market, buyers want to pay less. Sellers want to get more.
slides.title: Buyers and sellers

slides.text: The stock market is a place where people buy and sell stocks. It is a big fair for pieces of companies.
slides.title: The stock market

slides.text: An exchange is a business that runs a stock market. The NYSE and the Nasdaq are two big ones.
slides.title: Exchanges

slides.text: Prices move all day. More buyers push a price up. More sellers push it down.
slides.title: Prices move

options.text: A place where people buy and sell

questions.explanation: A market is a place where people buy and sell.

questions.prompt: Where do people buy and sell stocks?
questions.explanation: The stock market is where people buy and sell stocks.

questions.prompt: The NYSE and the Nasdaq are exchanges.
questions.explanation: Yes. They are two big US exchanges.

questions.prompt: Many buyers want a stock. What can happen to its price?
questions.explanation: More buyers push a price up.
People buy and sell at a market.
